fieldOptions.description: A list of options related to the field, applicable in contexts where multiple selections are allowed.

id.description: The unique ID of the field.

isRequired.description: Indicates whether the field is mandatory for the operation.

multiSelectFieldOptions.description: Specifies supported actions (like add, replace, remove) on multi-select fields via an enum.

name.description: The display name of the field.

searchUrl.description: A URL to fetch additional data for the field

unavailableMessage.description: A message indicating why the field is unavailable for editing.
